## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; sector-level participation is broad but leadership is mixed. Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5) with tech and consumer discretionary both contributing to the move.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities leading: VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing strength: MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weakest: DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND. Industrials mixed with notable weakness: DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND. Communication shows pockets of weakness: TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND; IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND; VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY; F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND; ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors represented), watch for narrowing if momentum concentrates.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SBUX (1W: -3.47% | 1M: +4.19%) CORRECTION; GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION; UBER (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -3.86%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION; INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in a mix of large-cap tech and select services names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND. Watch INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND as a momentum reversal risk and NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION as a tactical divergence.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed/rotational: AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +79.45%) ABOVE TREND, but NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION show short-term exhaustion. Sector breadth: Technology positive (24 stocks reported), monitor for concentration in chip names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive but uneven: V (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY—breadth is positive with selective strength in payments and banking. Style: rotation toward cyclicals/value elements within financials.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing broad participation: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND while UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION flags short-term pressure. Sector breadth: Healthcare positive and supported by multiple bullish catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective cyclicals and semiconductors (QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND) and consumer discretionary strength (F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to names showing short-term exhaustion (NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION). Monitor INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND for larger trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY; CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND) and Consumer Discretionary (F, ROST) on momentum. BEARISH: Materials (DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND) and select Industrials (DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim short-term strength (current action: NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION) as a trigger for broader tech rotation; QCOM/AAPL weekly follow-through above recent highs will confirm semiconductor-led rotation (QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND). Monitor INTU downside momentum (INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND) as a risk trigger for growth tech exposure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+65): triple-agonist GLP-1 news; LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MRK (+60): strong cancer data; MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. ROST (+55): beat/raise; ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. NVDA (+50): AI optics deal coverage; NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION — sentiment bullish but price shows short-term distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TTWO (-45): negative GTA6 commentary; TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION — news aligns with short-term weakness. UNH (-45): Medicare advantage scrutiny; UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirms near-term pressure. HD (-45): analyst caution; HD (1W: +5.23% | 1M: -7.96%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines diverge from short-term price strength, watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership as breadth is strong (10/11 sectors positive). LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is short-term exhaustion among large-cap tech — NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION — monitor sentiment/price divergences closely.
